text:
jen: Morning team — RC1 cutoff is in ~48h. Quick sync: we need the version bump PR merged, changelog entries up-to-date, and a green CI sweep. Any blocking flaky tests?

mike: Version bump PR is open -> #842. Needs one more review (cc @sara). I can merge after approvals.

sara: Reviewing now, should be done in an hour.

liam: Running one last local sweep. Seeing intermittent failures in Integration::Auth and e2e/browser-login.

nina: Noted flaky hits in Integration::Auth — seen in 3 runs on CI. I'll add them to the flaky-hotlist and quarantine.

ci-bot: Build status: nightly/rc1 -> failed on step "integration-tests" (auth). https://ci.redwood.example/build/5221

priya: For changelog: I added entries for optimize caching and routing fixes — PR #845. Needs copy sign-off.

jen: Thanks. Two action items: (1) @nina please quarantine Integration::Auth and add retry in the CI job; (2) @mike merge v-bump after @sara reviews. Also @priya please ping docs to sign off changelog copy.

nina: Quarantine done -> created branch flaky/quarantine/integration-auth and added to excluded-tests.yml. Snippet:
```
excluded:
  - Integration::Auth
```

mike: @sara approved, merging version bump now. Will trigger a CI run on main.

ci-bot: Build triggered: 1758032165. Running pipeline...

ci-bot: Pipeline update: integration-tests now passing in 2/2 runs. All green :tada:

jen: Awesome. I'll update release notes and send cutoff reminder to #announcements in 1h.

mike: Good job everyone :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks — moving the changelog PR forward.
